Hope you’re well — LogiQ here. Your annual renewal for log storage and inbound retention add-on is up on 2026-06-30. I’m attaching an initial renewal quote and our SOC2 evidence bundle for your procurement review.

Highlights from the quote (attached):
- Base storage (500TB/month): $0.08/GB-month, includes 30-day hot retention.
- Retention add-on (cold tier >30 days up to 365 days): $0.02/GB-month.
- One-time ingestion credits for commitment: optional.

2) Tell us if you need SSO/SCIM support, VPC peering, or specific data residency constraints.
3) If you require, we’ll produce a redlined contract and DocuSign link.

Hi Jake — thanks for the quote and the SOC2 bundle. A few clarifying items before we can finalize: 

1) Pricing options: please provide line items for 12-, 24-, and 36-month terms showing net pricing after the early-renewal discount (if applicable) and any ingestion credits. We prefer per-GB/month math in the quote so our finance model can compare.

2) Data controls: confirm support for:
   - SSO (SAML/SCIM) for user provisioning;
   - Customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest;
   - Export tools and expected egress performance (p95) for full restores.

3) Legal/terms: we will require a retention SLA and a deletion/certification process for data removed due to retention expiry or contractual deletion requests. Please state what audit logs you provide (access, deletion, admin changes).

4) Evidence: the SOC2 bundle is helpful but we need the table-of-contents and any current open exceptions called out. If you can add a summary “evidence index” to the bundle, that will speed our internal review.

I’m attaching our procurement_requirements.docx for your reference. If you can get back with an updated quote and a DocuSign-ready SOW by EOD Tue (May 26), we’ll aim to circle back with approvals.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement
